dataset: Zenodo 15309060, 11 processed participant CSVs, CC BY 4.0
task: Source-defined hypoglycemia point classification; not event alarm evaluation
training_validation: Remaining subjects in original CSV row order: first60% train, next20% validate; 120 row purge around each boundary. Row order is not claimed to be verified chronological time.
test: Entire unseen participant, no patient-specific calibration or test threshold tuning
selection: validation macro AP across training subjects; select model within each feature set
threshold: validation pooled Youden J with specificity >=0.8; point classification operating point only
notes: Published files lack timestamps/day identifiers; no event durations, false alarms/day or prospective validation claims. Missing source reference labels are excluded rather than imputed. Zero-coded absent wearable samples converted to NA, missingness not itself a feature. Sensors differ from PhysioCGM so this is independent cohort methodology exploration, not an external validation of the identical trained model.
